convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'STLMCandle' which is a non-standard custom indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management and money management logic. The custom indicator cannot be auto-converted without its source code.

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar end
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar end

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose triggered by signal reversal: when Clr[1]==2 (bullish signal) and SellPosClose enabled, closes sell positions; when Clr[1]==0 (bearish signal) and BuyPosClose enabled, closes buy positions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input value interpretation changes based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic reads STLMCandle buffer index 4 (color buffer). Clr[1]==2 means bullish candle color (buy signal); Clr[1]==0 means bearish candle color (sell signal); Clr[1]==1 would be neutral. Entry requires a transition: buy only if Clr[0]<2 (previous bar wasn't already bullish), sell only if Clr[0]>0 (previous bar wasn't already bearish). This prevents duplicate entries on consecutive same-color bars. When SignalBar==0, signals are recalculated on every tick (not just new bar). The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean input gates allowing selective enable/disable of each trade direction and close type.
python_conversion_notes: The STLMCandle custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It uses JLength (Jurik length=5) and JPhase (Jurik phase=100) parameters suggesting Jurik smoothing (JMA). The color buffer (buffer index 4) outputs 0=bearish, 1=neutral, 2=bullish. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory functions - these must be reimplemented. The 5 money management modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) need careful implementation. SL=1000 and TP=2000 are in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment needed since MT5 natively uses points. Signal timestamp logic (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) likely used for stop/order timing in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
